affectedSurfaces: agent-harness readiness protocol and capability artifacts
Antigravity CLI model and effort availability
hypothesis: Passing each resolved workflow or preset model/effort selection into the adapter-owned readiness probe will reject unavailable AGY catalog entries before agent launch without making static workflow validation host-dependent or duplicating the preset model registry.

metricsCompared.name: unavailable AGY selections reaching agent launch
metricsCompared.baseline: Runtime/auth readiness could pass while the selected effort-qualified model was absent from agy models, allowing launch to rely on provider fallback or late failure.
metricsCompared.candidate: 0 of 1 unavailable-selection integration cases reached the AGY run function; the failure and exact requested selection were recorded in the capability artifact.

metricsCompared.name: dynamic preset and readiness regression coverage
metricsCompared.baseline: Preset precedence tests named fixed shipped presets and parity preflight did not assert model/effort availability propagation.
metricsCompared.candidate: Preset precedence derives fixtures from the shipped registry; 98 preset/parity tests passed and the selection-aware parity contract passed without copying a shipped model literal.

metricsCompared.name: readiness and workflow regression coverage
metricsCompared.baseline: No shared readiness field represented an exact adapter-qualified model/effort selection.
metricsCompared.candidate: 180 focused tests plus 27 workflow, harness-parity, module-boundary, layout, docs, and strict-type gates passed.

rationale: The change reuses the existing adapter readiness and workflow capability-preflight mechanisms. AGY remains the sole authority for its live effort-qualified catalog, the shipped preset remains the sole model-routing registry, config tier overrides reach doctor, and definition validation remains deterministic. Unavailable selections fail closed before launch with inspectable evidence, while focused, parity, build, type, boundary, and policy validation passes.
